studies.title: Lake Baikal
studies.caption: Clear ice along Baikal’s shore gives way to the broad frozen surface of the lake.
studies.prompt: Shore-level winter study of Lake Baikal: clear blue broken lake-ice slabs in foreground, long frozen surface stretching toward low distant snow-dusted Siberian ridges, bare larch at one edge. Small restrained ice slabs, no towering Arctic icebergs.
